text:
Receptionist: Good morning, Brightside Dental, this is Megan.
Caller: Hi, um, I'd like to book a cleaning and a check-up. I haven't been to a dentist in, I don't know, about three years.
Receptionist: No problem at all. Are you a new patient with us?
Caller: Yes, I just moved to the area.
Receptionist: Great. Do you have dental insurance, or will you be paying out of pocket?
Caller: I have, uh, Delta something, through my employer. Let me grab the card. It's Delta Dental PPO.
Receptionist: Perfect, we're in network with that. For a new patient the first visit includes a full exam, X-rays, and a cleaning. With your plan it's usually covered at one hundred percent for the exam and cleaning, and X-rays at eighty.
Caller: Oh nice. And if I need a filling or something?
Receptionist: Fillings are typically covered at eighty percent after your deductible. We'd give you an estimate before any treatment.
Caller: Okay. What do you have open this week?
Receptionist: I have Thursday at nine fifteen or Friday at two.
Caller: Friday at two is good.
Receptionist: Booked. Can I get your name and date of birth?
Caller: Daniel Brooks, March the ninth, nineteen eighty-eight.
Receptionist: Thanks, Daniel. Please arrive fifteen minutes early to fill out forms. Bring your insurance card and a photo ID.

metadata.note: Booking a dental cleaning with a new patient
